summary: Take the first row-major color-5 cell as source; take every grid cell whose color is not 0, 5, or 6 as the original global motif; take every color-6 cell in row-major order as an anchor. Translate every original motif cell from source to each anchor, preserve its color, clip out-of-bounds targets, and apply stamps sequentially so later anchors win overlaps and may overwrite source or anchor markers.
